shell_commands: npm run typecheck 2>&1 && npm run eslint 2>&1
npm run eslint 2>&1 && npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "Test Suites:|Tests:" | head -10
npm run typecheck 2>&1 && npm run eslint 2>&1 | tail -5

git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: correct AJV import and add input validation to ToolRegistry.execute

- Import Ajv as default export instead of named import
- Add cause to thrown schema compilation error for better error tracking  
- Validate tool input against registered schema before executing
- Return ToolResponse with validation errors instead of calling executor
- Extract intermediate values in test to avoid member chain depth lint error
- Use early return pattern in test provider to flatten happy path

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

npm run typecheck 2>&1 && echo "✓ typecheck passed" && npm run eslint 2>&1 && echo "✓ eslint passed" && npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "Test Suites:|Tests:|PASS|FAIL" | head -10
